name: beatdeck
description: Talks as beats, not slides: a fixed 1920×1080 React stage where one click is one beat. Offline, deterministic, with presenter view.
author: Borja Pérez Francés

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p . && vite build && node scripts/check-offline.mjs dist deck
scripts.build:kernel-panic: tsc --noEmit -p . && vite build --mode kernel-panic && node scripts/check-offline.mjs dist-kernel-panic examples/kernel-panic
scripts.present:kernel-panic: npm run build:kernel-panic && vite preview --mode kernel-panic --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --strictPort --open
